description.text:
(Translated from Chinese by AI)
1. Incremental mod list loading optimization (scan and display in batches, filtering no longer rescans).  
2. Corrupted mod files are now skipped with a prompt instead of failing the whole mod list; confirmation dialog added for deleting corrupted mods.  
3. Fixed F3 page CPU showing "Unknown" on some devices.  
4. Fixed some rendering errors.  
5. Fixed crash when GLFW window context creation fails.  
6. Fixed LWJGL freetype library loading from the packaged natives directory.  
7. Account skin upload reimplemented with coroutines instead of Task.  
8. Removed the NG-GL4ES submodule, using prebuilt artifacts from the standalone project.

(若启动器内下载缓慢请使用网盘下载,64位的请下载arm64，不知道该下哪个的请下载all）
1.模组列表增量加载优化（边扫描边分批显示，筛选不再重新扫描）
2.损坏的模组文件跳过并提示，避免整个模组列表加载失败，并支持确认删除
3.修复部分设备 F3 页面 CPU 显示为 Unknown 的问题
4.修复部分渲染错误
5.修复 GLFW 窗口上下文创建失败时导致的崩溃
6.修复 LWJGL freetype 库从打包 natives 目录加载的问题
7.账号皮肤上传改为协程实现
8.移除 NG-GL4ES 子模块，改用独立项目预构建产物
